18.note: V5 wins with natural Chilean payment language and the complete request. V1 and V4 omit the request to pay promptly; V4 also changes an unpaid invoice into a payment not yet reflected. V3 drops the offer to answer questions. V6 changes confirmation from 'us' to 'me'.

The other versions preserve the facts.
